note: Whether resting escapes the cost of crossing or only renames it. Fill is decided by a later print from the opposite aggressor reaching the resting price; queue position cannot be known from the archive, so the strict reading — a print trading THROUGH the level, which means the queue there was cleared — is the one to plan on. Unfilled attempts are excluded rather than scored as zero: an order that never filled earns nothing, and averaging non-trades in dilutes the losses and flatters the result. takerOnMissed is the adverse selection test: if crossing did well precisely on the signals a passive order missed, the passive order is being handed the losers by construction.
